QuestInfo.name: [Valentine's Day] Candy Score Achievements
QuestInfo.0:
Get awesome gifts for the Candy Points you accumulate!

#r5,000 Points: #bHard Cube
#r10,000 Points: #bHard Cube x2
#r15,000 Points: #bMiraculous Chaos Scroll 60%
#r20,000 Points: #bBonus Potential Scroll 60%
#r30,000 Points: #bEpic Potential Scroll 50%
#r40,000 Points: #bStellar Weapon + Hard Cube
#r50,000 Points: #bProtection Scroll

#r#eTIP:#k After 50,000 Points, the rewards you receive will reset, and start again at the Hard Cube. You can get each reward up to 2 times each day.
